meta.name: start-work
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says start work, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行计划,由多个智能体分工推进并持续记录进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果已经排好一份计划,想交给 AI 智能体按步骤执行并保持进度同步
copy.tagline_en: Run your plan with parallel agents and keep progress tracked.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a ready plan and want AI agents to execute it while keeping progress tracked.

howto.what: 这项技能让 Claude 变为执行总控：它读取工作计划，把写代码、测试、检查等任务拆开，交给多个并行子代理完成；自己只做调度、记录进度和验收，不亲手写代码，直至计划全部通关。
howto.when: 在制定好计划之后，当你说出“start work”、“execute plan”等指令，或要求执行 .omo/plans 下的计划时触发；若上次计划未完成，Claude 也会自动续接。

say.note: Claude 会挑选现有计划并启动执行。

say.text: 继续执行上次没做完的计划。
say.note: Claude 会从上次断点接着推进。
完成后会创建 pull request。

howto.what_en: This skill turns Claude into an orchestrator: it reads a work plan, breaks implementation, testing, and review into tasks, and delegates them to parallel subagents. Claude itself only schedules, records progress, and verifies results—it never writes product code—until every checkbox is done.
howto.when_en: Triggers after planning when the user says 'start work', 'execute plan', etc., or asks to run a plan in .omo/plans. Also auto-resumes when a previous session left unchecked plan work in .omo/boulder.json.

say_en.note: Claude will pick a plan and launch it.

say_en.text: Continue the unfinished plan from last time.
say_en.note: Claude resumes from the last checkpoint.
A pull request will be created on completion.
